name: land-a-job
description: 本地优先、Agent 原生的求职流水线

scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @land/core && npm run dev -w @land/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @land/resume-kit && npm run build -w @land/core && npm run build -w @land/server && npm run build -w @land/mcp && npm run build -w @land/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @land/resume-kit && tsc -b packages/core/tsconfig.json apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.e2e: npm run build && node scripts/e2e/p3.mjs && node scripts/e2e/p4.mjs && node scripts/e2e/p5.mjs && node scripts/e2e/p6.mjs && node scripts/e2e/p7.mjs
